character.galleryFull: Remove an image before adding another.
character.nameRequired: A first or last name is enough; the rest can wait.

location.typeInUse: Open the location list, filter by this type and change it, then try again.
location.parentCycle: Pick a parent location that isn't inside this one.
location.galleryFull: Remove an image before adding another.
location.typeDuplicate: Give the type another name, or use the existing one.
